headlineOfDay: A $2.9tn Wall Street tech rout, triggered by fears that a Democratic Congress will curb AI and data centres, spreads to Asia and Europe.

markets.summary: Wall Street suffered its worst tech sell-off since 2020: the Nasdaq fell 5.5%, the S&P 500 4.4% and the Dow 3.4%. Investors feared Democratic midterm wins would bring tougher scrutiny of AI and data centre build-outs. London and Europe followed lower, with the FTSE 100 down 1.4% and the Euro Stoxx 50 down 1.0%, while Tadawul rose 0.6%.

commodities.label: Brent crude
commodities.note: Brent is on course for a sharp weekly loss on hopes the Iran war could ease after the US midterms, though it rebounded on Thursday and Friday as traders weighed renewed US-Iran conflict risks.

rates_fx.note: Sterling hit its highest level against a basket of currencies since the 2016 Brexit vote, after the dollar fell following the US midterms.
